datasets.name: Google Earth imagery
datasets.verbatim: The optical image data utilized in this study were obtained from Google Earth and feature a spatial resolution of 1.06 m.

datasets.name: ALOS DEM data
datasets.verbatim: The DEM data employed for mapping the landslide extent vector data were sourced from ALOS (Advanced Land Observation Satellite), with a pixel resolution of 12.5 m × 12.5 m.

datasets.name: Coseismic landslide vector data (Wenchuan, Ludian, Jiuzhaigou)
datasets.source: Publicly available coseismic landslide vector data
datasets.verbatim: This selection is based on publicly available coseismic landslide vector data from the aforementioned earthquakes [53–55]

methods.name: ResUNet–BFA
methods.summary: A deep learning model for landslide recognition that uses ResNet50 as an encoder and incorporates a lightweight boundary-focused attention (BFA) mechanism at the output of the final residual block. The BFA mechanism integrates Canny edge detection results with the original feature map to enhance boundary feature representation, while the decoder uses a U-Net architecture to restore spatial resolution.
methods.source: Zhao, Z.; Tan, S.; Yang, Y.; Zhang, Q.
methods.verbatim: The related code and data are available at https://github.com/zhao952711/landslides_identification.git (accessed on 1 March 2025).
